27336-three-women.title: Three Women
27336-three-women.creator: Unknown
27336-three-women.description: A public-domain book from Project Gutenberg. Maurice Somerville passed the cluster of girls   Who twisted their ribbons and fluttered their curls   In vain to attract him; his mind it was plain   Was wholly intent on the incoming train. That great one eyed monster puffed out its black breath,   Shrieked, snorted and hissed, like a thing bent on death,   Paused scarcely a moment, and then sped away,   And two actors more now enliven our play.

arxiv-2211-01213.title: FiFo : Fishbone Forwarding in Massive IoT Networks
arxiv-2211-01213.creator: Hayoung Seong, Junseon Kim, Won-Yong Shin, and Howon Lee
arxiv-2211-01213.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Hayoung Seong, Junseon Kim, Won-Yong Shin, and Howon Lee. Massive Internet of Things (IoT) networks have a wide range of applications, including but not limited to the rapid delivery of emergency and disaster messages. Although various benchmark algorithms have been developed to date for message delivery in such applications, they pose several practical challenges such as insufficient network coverage and/or highly redundant transmissions to expand the coverage area, resulting in considerable energy consumption for each IoT device.

arxiv-2508-03672.title: Inland-LOAM: Voxel-Based Structural Semantic Mapping for Inland Waterways
arxiv-2508-03672.creator: Zhongbi Luo, Yunjia Wang, Jan Swevers, Peter Slaets, Herman Bruyninckx
arxiv-2508-03672.description: Abstract Accurate and up-to-date geospatial information is crucial for enhancing the safety and autonomy of Inland Waterway Transport (IWT). Inland Electronic Navigational Charts (IENC) often lack detailed real-time information, conventional LiDAR-based Simultaneous Localization and Mapping (SLAM) methods have difficulty handling distinctive inland waterway characteristics, such as dynamic shorelines and challenging reflective water surfaces.

arxiv-2509-15788.title: FoBa: A Foreground-Background co-Guided Method and New Benchmark for Remote Sensing Semantic Change Detection
arxiv-2509-15788.creator: Haotian Zhang, Han Guo, Keyan Chen, Hao Chen, Zhengxia Zou, Zhenwei Shi, Beihang University, Shanghai Artificial Intelligence Laboratory
arxiv-2509-15788.description: Abstract Despite the remarkable progress achieved in remote sensing semantic change detection (SCD), two major challenges remain. At the data level, existing SCD datasets suffer from limited change categories, insufficient change types, and a lack of fine-grained class definitions, making them inadequate to fully support practical applications.

britannica-1911-inglefield-sir-edward-au.title: Inglefield, Sir Edward Augustus (1911 Encyclopaedia Britannica article)
britannica-1911-inglefield-sir-edward-au.creator: Encyclopaedia Britannica
britannica-1911-inglefield-sir-edward-au.description: Article 'Inglefield, Sir Edward Augustus' from the 1911 Encyclopædia Britannica (Volume 14), the classic English-language general encyclopedia, now in the public domain. British admiral and explorer, was born at Cheltenham, on the 27th of March 1820, and educated at the Royal Naval College, Portsmouth. His father was Rear-Admiral Samuel Hood Inglefield (1783–1848), and his grandfather Captain John Nicholson Inglefield (1748–1828), who served with Lord Hood against the French.

pmc-10514058.title: The transfer of 137Cs and heavy metals to tissues within the organs of snails
pmc-10514058.creator: Zhanat Baigazinov, Sergey Lukashenko, Batiyash Silybayeva, Klara Zharykbasova, Zhanylkhan Bukabayeva, Nurlan Muhamediarov, Bagdat Kantbayeva, Balzhan Kozhakhmetova, Tuvshinsaikhan Ganbaatar, Edit Toth-Bodrogi, Miklos Hegedus, Tibor Kovacs
pmc-10514058.description: This paper describes the dynamics of 137Cs accumulation and its concentration ratio as well as that of some stable elements in the body, shell, gastrointestinal tract and albumin gland of a particular species of snail (terrestrial gastropod), namely the Giant African snail (Lissachatina fulica), after the long-term ingestion of contaminated forage and/or soil.

pmc-10625701.title: The Tendency to Avoid Physical Activity and Sport Scale (TAPAS): Rasch analysis with differential item functioning testing among a Chinese sample
pmc-10625701.creator: Chia-Wei Fan, Yen-Ling Chang, Po-Ching Huang, Xavier C C Fung, Ji-Kang Chen, Nadia Bevan, Kerry S O’Brien, Ya-Chin Yeh, Hsin-Pao Chen, I-Hua Chen, I-Ching Lin, Mark D Griffiths, Chung-Ying Lin
pmc-10625701.description: BackgroundThe benefits of physical activity are well-known to prevent multiple long-term health conditions. Physical appearance and weight-related stigma may influence individuals’ decision to engage in physical activity and sport. Therefore, the present study examined the psychometric properties of a newly developed instrument, the Tendency to Avoid Physical Activity and Sport Scale (TAPAS), using modern test theory.

pmc-10648968.title: Pain in Colorectal Surgery: How Does It Occur and What Tools Do We Have for Treatment?
pmc-10648968.creator: Robert Ivascu, Madalina Dutu, Alina Stanca, Mihai Negutu, Darius Morlova, Costin Dutu, Dan Corneci
pmc-10648968.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2023). Pain is a complex entity with deleterious effects on the entire organism. Poorly controlled postoperative pain impacts the patient outcome, being associated with increased morbidity, inadequate quality of life and functional recovery. In the current surgical environment with less invasive surgical procedures increasingly being used and a trend towards rapid discharge home after surgery, we need to continuously re-evaluate analgesic strategies.

pmc-11686031.title: Discovering Time-Varying Public Interest for COVID-19 Case Prediction in South Korea Using Search Engine Queries: Infodemiology Study
pmc-11686031.creator: Seong-Ho Ahn, Kwangil Yim, Hyun-Sik Won, Kang-Min Kim, Dong-Hwa Jeong, Amaryllis Mavragani, June Young Chun, Shihao Yang
pmc-11686031.description: BackgroundThe number of confirmed COVID-19 cases is a crucial indicator of policies and lifestyles. Previous studies have attempted to forecast cases using machine learning techniques that use a previous number of case counts and search engine queries predetermined by experts. However, they have limitations in reflecting temporal variations in queries associated with pandemic dynamics.

pmc-12419492.title: Chronic Type B Aortic Dissection With Aneurysmal Dilatation Presenting With Recurrent Seizures: A Case Report
pmc-12419492.creator: Parto Siavosh, Jaafar Al-Sadiq Jaf, Seyed Hossien Shaker
pmc-12419492.description: Aortic aneurysms can remain asymptomatic or present with complications, including aortic dissection. Aortic dissection itself may manifest with a wide spectrum of signs and symptoms, which can make diagnosis challenging.A 63-year-old man is discussed in this article, who presented with episodes of seizure. He had a history of type B aortic dissection being treated medically.

pmc-12664582.title: Preferences for harm reduction vending machine design among rural people who use drugs
pmc-12664582.creator: April M Young, Tasfia Jahangir, Susan Westneat, Chelsi Cheatom, Amanda Fallin-Bennett, Laura C Fanucchi, Patricia R Freeman, Jennifer R Havens, Hannah K Knudsen, Kathryn E McCollister, Susannah Stitzer, Jack Stone, Peter Vickerman, Melvin D Livingston
pmc-12664582.description: Globally, harm reduction vending machines (HRVMs) have been used for decades to dispense safe injection equipment and other supplies to people who use drugs (PWUD). However, HRVMs have only recently scaled up in the U.S. and few operate in rural settings. This study describes preferences for HRVM design among rural PWUD in two Appalachian Kentucky communities.

pmc-12687062.title: Ivabradine in acute care: Revisiting the funny current in critical care context
pmc-12687062.creator: Arun Mukesh, Ankur Sharma, Nikhil Kothari
pmc-12687062.description: Ivabradine, a selective inhibitor of the funny current in the sinoatrial node, has emerged as a promising agent for heart rate modulation in acute and critical care settings. Unlike beta-blockers, ivabradine reduces heart rate without affecting myocardial contractility, making it a valuable option for patients contraindicated for traditional therapies.

pmc-12698480.title: Advances in colorectal cancer screening: technological innovations, guideline discrepancies, and individualized strategies
pmc-12698480.creator: Li Tang, Xiaoyong Zhao, Guohong Wang, Jiehao Huang, Mu Zhang, Wei Xu
pmc-12698480.description: Colorectal cancer (CRC) is the second leading cause of cancer-related mortality worldwide. Numerous clinical and epidemiological studies have demonstrated that early screening can significantly reduce both the incidence and mortality of CRC. This review systematically summarizes recent advances in CRC screening technologies.

pmc-13301462.title: Research Progress and Translational Perspectives of Piezoelectric Materials in Dental Implant Surface Engineering
pmc-13301462.creator: Xu Cao, Jiangqi Hu, Qian Pang, Qingsong Jiang, Su Chen, Bin Luo
pmc-13301462.description: The long-term stability of dental implants is limited by multiple factors, including peri-implant infection, impaired osseointegration, and poor soft tissue sealing. Compared with conventional passive surface modification strategies, piezoelectric materials can convert mechanical energy into local electrical signals under occlusal loading, cell traction, or ultrasonic stimulation.

uslaw-usc-t45-s661.title: 45 U.S.C. § 661 — Definitions
uslaw-usc-t45-s661.creator: United States Congress
uslaw-usc-t45-s661.description: United States Code, Title 45 (Railroads); Chapter 15 (Emergency Rail Services). Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel. For the purposes of this chapter— (1) “Secretary” means the Secretary of Transportation. (2) “Board” means the Surface Transportation Board. (3) “Railroad” means any rail carrier subject to part A of subtitle IV of title 49. (4) “Certificate” means certificates issued by trustees of a railroad.
